## Checklist

- [ ] If the format changed: `docs/SPEC.md` updated (and a UEP for larger changes)
- [ ] New user-facing text goes through `uniwire.i18n` (English and French)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No personal data or copyrighted material in examples or tests
